examples.arabic: روحنا سوق كبير اوي فيه محلات كتير
examples.english: We went to a very big market with many shops.
examples.transliteration: Rohna soo' kibeer awi feeh mahallat keteer.
examples.storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

examples.arabic: كنا بنروح محلات الفساتين عشان نختار فستان العروسة
examples.english: We used to go to dress shops to choose the bride's dress.
examples.transliteration: Konna benrooh ma7allat el fasateen 3ashan nekhtar fostan el 3aroosa.

examples.english: We went to the big market to see the shops.
examples.storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

examples.arabic: بعد خطوات قليلة، سمعت منى صوت مألوف بين المحلات القديمة: إزيك يا منى، أخيرا لقيتك، كنت بفكر أروح خلاص!
examples.english: After a few steps, Mona heard a familiar voice among the old shops: "How are you, Mona, I finally found you, I was thinking of leaving already!"
examples.transliteration: Ba3d khotowat 'alila, sem3et Mona sout ma'louf bein el-ma7allat el-'adima: "Izzayek ya Mona, akhiran la'eitki, kont ba'fakkar arou7 khalas!"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili
